_comment: Manual provision overrides for bills where LLM auto-extraction needs correction.
_format: bill_id → {description, policies: [...], unmapped_provisions: [...], override_reason, mapped_by, mapped_date}

hr-7024-118.description: Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act of 2024

policies.provision_text: Expands Child Tax Credit and restores bonus depreciation and R&D expensing

hr-7024-118.override_reason: Confirmed against CBO score of -$33.5B; CTC expansion + R&D/depreciation provisions

hr-1-119.description: P.L. 119-21 (H.R. 1, 119th Congress) — 2025 reconciliation act as enacted

policies.provision_text: Permanently extends the TCJA individual rate cuts, standard deduction, CTC, 199A, AMT relief, and estate exemption. P.L. 119-21 did not cut the corporate statutory rate; it remains 21%.

unmapped_provisions: SNAP work requirements and other Agriculture title changes
Medicaid work requirements and other health-coverage changes
Temporary deductions for tips, overtime, and car-loan interest
SALT cap raised to $40,000 through 2029 (the calculator's TCJA path models the $10,000 cap, not the $40,000 path)
Bonus depreciation, R&D expensing, and other cost-recovery changes
hr-1-119.override_reason: P.L. 119-21 as enacted 4 July 2025 did not cut the corporate rate to 20% (IRC §11 remains 21%). Only the TCJA individual extension is mapped; remaining titles are listed unmapped so confidence cannot be high. CBO's as-enacted estimate is publication 61570 ($3.4T over FY2025-2034), not publication 61560.
